senses.definition_en: measles

examples.english: Measles attack men at any age, but more frequently at a young one.
examples.ref: 1799, Joseph Quarin, “Del sarampión”, in Antonio Lavedán, transl., Prontuario de medicina clínica ó práctica, Madrid, page 88:
examples.text: Los sarampiones atacan á los hombres en toda edad; pero mas freqüentemente en la tierna.
examples.translation: Measles attack men at any age, but more frequently at a young one.

examples.english: Measles is one of the most contagious diseases in the world and it may lead to severe complications such as encephalitis, blindness, deafness and even death in one in a thousand children.
examples.ref: 2026 February 1, Daniela Guazo, “Un contagio por hora: la epidemia de sarampión que México no pudo frenar [One infection per hour: the measles epidemic that Mexico couldn't stop]”, in El Universal (Mexico), archived from the original on 02 Feb 2026:
examples.text: El sarampión es una de las enfermedades más contagiosas en el mundo y puede llegar a causar complicaciones graves como encefalitis, ceguera, sordera e incluso la muerte en uno de cada mil niños.
examples.translation: Measles is one of the most contagious diseases in the world and it may lead to severe complications such as encephalitis, blindness, deafness and even death in one in a thousand children.

glosses: measles
